quote: For assessment of the synthesized speech, we conduct a detailed analysis using [...] We evaluate using Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER) for ASR, macro-F1 for SLID, and multiple metrics including Mel-Cepstral Distortion (MCD), Log F0 Root Mean Square Error (LogF0RMSE), SpeechTokenDistance, Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), UTMOS (a predicted Mean Opinion Score, MOS), and Speech-BERTScore for TTS.

For TTS, we assess synthesized speech intelligibility ... reporting WER, CER, Mel-Cepstral Distortion (MCD), Log F0 Root Mean Square Error (LogF0RMSE), SpeechTokenDistance, PESQ, UTMOS, SpeechBLEU, SpeechBERTScore ...

For TTS, we use WER, Mel-Cepstral Distortion (MCD) , Log F0 Root Mean Square Error (LogF0RMSE) , SpeechTokenDistance , Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ) , UTMOS (a predicted Mean Opinion Score, MOS) , and Speech-BERTScore .
This strong performance is further corroborated by its high scores in humanrated naturalness (3.76 UTMOS) and semantic similarity (0.89 SpeechBERTScore).
